import.title: Import members from CSV
import.subtitle: Add families and persons in bulk from the Sabha's existing records.
import.rule1: One row per person. Rows with the same membershipNo belong to one family.
import.rule2: Mark the head with relation SELF (or make headName equal to the name). Dates: YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
import.rule3: A family with any invalid row is skipped completely. Existing membership numbers get the new persons added.
